name: squat-smith-machine
title: Squat: Smith Machine
primer: This exercise is a variation of a squat using the Smith Machine.
steps: Set the height of the barbell to shoulder height.
Place your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart with your knees and toes pointed slightly outward.
Drawing your abs in, descend slowly by bending at the knees and hips as if you are sitting down (squatting).
Lower yourself as far as you can control without letting your body shift over your toes (this will cause you to lose balance).
Pause in the downward squatting position and slowly return upright to the starting position.
tips: If needed, a pad on the bar or towel on your shoulders can help improve your grip and reduce the discomfort of the bar against your back.
First practise the squat without any weight to allow yourself to become comfortable with the movements.
